## Description
Update plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with a new section documenting the 5 provision-ruleset.sh knobs:

- bypass_actor_policy
- require_conversation_resolution
- request_copilot_review
- dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push

If any of these are also dso-config.conf keys (per the parent story 0f6e-9b79 onboarding integration), document both surfaces.
